newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea KFA passes on 70,000T soymeal tender-trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea KFA passes on 70,000T soymeal tender-trade.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) passed on tenders for a total of 70,000 tonnes of soymeal due to high prices, traders said on Tuesday.
They said shipment for the tender was originally set for January 11-30 if sourced from China, for December 27-January 15 if from India, or for December 1-20 if from South America or the U.S. Gulf.
They said arrival ports were set for Inchon, Kunsan, Pusan or Ulsan.
One trader said the lowest bid for Indian-sourced soymeal was made by Adani at $305 per tonne C&F. He added the association may soon re-invite a tender for the same amount.
